name: Financial Assistance to the Family of Temple Employees
benefit: **Financial Benefit:** An amount of ₹5,000/- is granted under the Group Insurance Scheme. **Financial Benefit:** An amount of ₹20,000/- is granted under the Chief Minister’s Welfare Fund. **Intended Use of Benefit:** The amounts are granted to the family of the temple employee who expire while in service.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a family member of the deceased employee of the temple. - The temple employee must have died while in service.
